- [x] **T-045** Verify the vault-isolation leak stays closed (session 148) — **FIXED and SHIPPED as v0.22.1 (`e633fcb`, diagnosed by Atlas, committed by Forge, Session 53). The guard caught its own committer on day one.** The test suite had been writing session summaries into Aaron's **real** Obsidian vault: 13 files named `2026-08-31-ob-server-{slug}.md`, 69 bytes each, frontmatter `project: ob-server-Cz4UxZ` with an empty `sessionId` and a body of `test`. Found at `/end` while listing `Summaries/`. **This is a recurrence with the guard already in place** — `tests/setup-env.ts` has set `OPEN_BRAIN_VAULT_DIR` to a temp vault since the 57-file incident in April, and `vitest.config.ts` loads it. **Root cause — CORRECTED after shipping; the first diagnosis named a real hazard but not the producer.** The demonstrated producer is **`npx vitest` run from the REPO ROOT**: there is no `vitest.config.*` above `open-brain/`, so a root-level run discovers the tests by default glob and loads **no config at all** — `setupFiles` never executes, `OPEN_BRAIN_VAULT_DIR` is never set, and the whole suite runs unisolated against the real vault.
